mj-prompt-optimizer 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Midjourney Prompt Optimizer skill.
- Automatically filters sensitive words and enhances styles for Chinese-to-English MJ prompts, with no user reminders.
- Implements rule-based replacement for common sensitive terms and combination triggers specific to Midjourney.
- Outputs ready-to-use English prompts with standard suffixes for image generation.
